summary: Extended the retry-growth investigation to its admitted half, which had remained source-only in the asserted account's limitations. The harness now drives both paths in one invocation: the existing isolated-leader case (voters {1,2,3}, no quorum acks) plus a new two-voter case where the leader's self-ack and node 2's MsgAppResp are delivered so the leader legitimately commits in its term, after which 64 same-context retries are admitted while per-round MsgHeartbeat messages are counted. A local run confirms the new setup records committed=1, in_term=true, CheckQuorum=false, ReadOnlySafe, and the probe records unconfirmed=64, broadcasts=64, confirmed=0, pending=0. Submitted as a successor experiment for the same investigation with four comparisons (pending==64, pending_after==64, unconfirmed==64, broadcasts==64) so the controller can produce the receipt; the existing interpretation and its asserted defect claim are deliberately left unrevised until that receipt exists.
